applicationRules: Apply the active semantic theme before rendering the current review section.
Treat density and control size as first-class review dimensions, not browser-only options.
Keep the GPUI preview app wired to emitted tokens rather than preview-local constants.

evidenceCapture: native screenshots for stable theme and section states
recorded inspection notes for token application and layout issues
theme plus section snapshots that can be compared against Svelte review routes
sideBySideExpectations: catalog-hub should mirror section ownership and review entry points closely enough to compare navigation and metadata posture.
token-summary-section should expose live values for the same semantic token families across the same theme and density states.
token-inspector should allow searchable token inspection even if the native presentation differs from the browser inspector.

nonGoals: Do not build the full GPUI component catalogue before the review shell and theme runtime exist.
Do not require pixel-identical shell chrome when native presentation can still satisfy the same review job honestly.
Do not infer broader GPUI component parity from the preview app baseline alone.
